ast_and_import_graph_gate.details: Live AST scanning across all test files, fixtures, conftest, and smoke suites enforces that total main importers is strictly bounded (<= 205) and strictly decreased from audited baseline (218). Migrated suites must never import main or mutate sys.path, and conftest.py and shared fixtures are verified to never mutate sys.path.

truthful_fixture_provenance_and_auth_iso.details: Eliminated copied auth policy and duplicate role checking fakes across all test fixtures (including settings and consultation suites). Injected fixed typed OperatorIdentity and standard Mock recording authorization callbacks for success cases, asserting expected typed identity was passed to the callbacks. For all 13 missing-auth 401 cases across ASK suites, explicitly configured rejecting mock extractors and asserted that extract_identity received None, authorization callbacks were not called, domain/store operations did not execute via store spies, and store state remained untouched. Restored truthful local_snapshot provenance for in-memory read store in test_ask_004 instead of misleading service_store label.

instance_bound_isolation_and_concurrency.details: Nested client tests verify instance-bound store/idempotency isolation where inner client operations exit without wiping outer client replay cache (outer replay 409 preserved). Concurrent client tests using ThreadPoolExecutor verify thread-safe parallel request handling and cross-client data isolation across simultaneous clients using deterministic two-barrier synchronization (clients_ready_barrier and writes_completed_barrier) before cross-visibility assertions.

coordination_note: Production composition wiring in main.py and runtime modules was preserved unmodified in accordance with the task brief scope constraint. Fixture auth policy drift was eliminated in favor of typed OperatorIdentity and recording callbacks. True instance-bound and concurrent client isolation verified for ASK suites.
